source: Synteny, computed (NCBI RefSeq NC_004463.1 vs NC_014323.1) + PMID 27059806
claim_tested: bll6422 belongs to a flavonoid catabolic operon
key_finding: 10 of the 11 fde genes have 1:1 counterparts in bll6421-bll6430, same order, 45.9-81.2% identity; 7 intergenic gaps of 4, -4, 25, 79, 39, -17, 25 bp
organism_assay_context: B. diazoefficiens USDA110 genome vs H. seropedicae SmR1
confidence_and_limitations: high for synteny; the Hsero pathway is defined genetically, not by purified enzymes

source: Computed, AlphaFold Q89GC3 v6 vs PDB 1HYO chain A
claim_tested: bll6422 is a C-C bond hydrolase, not a hydratase
key_finding: 266 equivalent CA at 1.55 A, 19.5% core identity; His133->His91 0.93 A, Glu199->Glu140 0.87 A, Glu201->Glu142 0.55 A, Asp233->Asp171 1.14 A, Asp126->Asp84 0.76 A, Thr350->Thr264 0.98 A; Arg142 replaced by Lys101
confidence_and_limitations: model-based; no experimental structure of bll6422

claim_tested: the Glu-His dyad defines FAH C-C hydrolase chemistry
key_finding: FAH structure with products: acetoacetate on an octahedral Ca2+ next to a Glu-His dyad; Glu-His-water catalytic triad proposed
confidence_and_limitations: mechanism inferred from structure, not from mutagenesis in that paper

claim_tested: no structurally characterised close homolog has an assayed reaction
key_finding: closest structural relative 3LZK, CA RMSD 0.94 A over 297 residues; 3LZK is a structural-genomics entry with no reported activity

claim_tested: the operon responds to a soybean isoflavone
key_finding: operon mean log2FC +1.213 (8 genes), sliding-window genomic null empirical P = 0.0072; bll6422 +0.596 at raw p = 0.139; nod controls +3.6 to +6.5; all BH q > 0.05 at n = 3
organism_assay_context: USDA110, AG medium, 8 h, 5 uM genistein
confidence_and_limitations: single laboratory, n = 3, two-fold effect; per-gene FDR not reached

claim_tested: the response is regulated, not a growth artefact
key_finding: nodW mutant +0.021 (P = 0.338) and nodW nwsA d901 +0.193 (P = 0.178) while blr2027 reaches +5.5 in d901
confidence_and_limitations: mutant arms compared with uninduced wild type; genotype and treatment confounded

claim_tested: the operon is not a general phenolic stress response
key_finding: pterocarpan P6 20 uM 24 h: operon mean +0.026, empirical P = 0.434, Mann-Whitney p = 0.608
confidence_and_limitations: uninformative about flavonoid specificity because nod genes also fail to respond in this series

claim_tested: bll6422 is not interchangeable with the annotated hydratase paralogs
key_finding: 21-30% identity to every FAH-family paralog in USDA110; those annotated 2-oxopent-4-enoate hydratase are 259 and 268 aa against 344 aa
confidence_and_limitations: annotation of the paralogs is itself computational

claim_tested: the pathway gene set is complete but rearranged
key_finding: fdeG counterpart BJA_RS30665, 258 aa, 69.3% identity, at 6,674,635-6,675,411, 396 kb from the locus, in a non-aromatic neighbourhood
confidence_and_limitations: co-regulation of BJA_RS30665 with the operon is untested

claim_tested: the fde genes act in naringenin degradation
key_finding: genetic definition of the fde operon in H. seropedicae SmR1
confidence_and_limitations: different organism; transfer to USDA110 is inference from synteny

source: Computed: Smith-Waterman of Q89GC3 vs all 99 reviewed Swiss-Prot PF01557 entries
claim_tested: bll6422 belongs to the C-C hydrolase branch, not the hydratase branch
key_finding: Top hit Q1NEI7 (LRA6, EC 3.7.1.26), SW 151, 29.1% identity over 165 columns, experimental catalytic activity (ECO:0000269). Characterised 2-oxopent-4-enoate hydratases reach only SW 32-40 over 17-36 columns. 24 of 99 reviewed entries have an experimentally evidenced reaction
confidence_and_limitations: Best characterised match is below 30% identity, so substrate does not transfer. Ranking covers reviewed entries only.

source: Computed: PDB 8GSR chain A (Mg2+ and pyruvate complex) on AlphaFold Q89GC3
claim_tested: the LRA6 catalytic machinery is present in bll6422
key_finding: 232 equivalent CA at 1.65 A, 21.6% core identity. His78->His91 1.35 A, Glu119->Glu140 0.62 A, Glu121->Glu142 0.30 A, Asp150->Asp171 0.88 A, Arg154->Arg175 0.64 A, Lys168->Lys192 0.45 A, Thr238->Thr264 2.11 A. Experimental Mg2+ lands 2.06 A from Glu142 OE1, 2.34 A from Glu140 OE2, 2.73 A from Asp84 OD2, 3.39 A from Asp171 OD2. Not conserved: Glu81->Leu94, Gln157->Gly178, Lys158->Ala179
organism_assay_context: in silico, against an experimental metal position
confidence_and_limitations: Independent of 1HYO and 3LZK in template and metal species. Still a model on one side, no ligand complex for bll6422.

claim_tested: the substrate class is aromatic rather than aliphatic
key_finding: LRA6 position 84 is the specificity switch between LRA6 (Leu84) and the fumarylpyruvate hydrolase subfamily (Arg86). bll6422 has Arg93 there, CA 1.98 A from the projected Leu84 CA
organism_assay_context: Sphingomonas sp. LRA6 structure plus in silico transfer
confidence_and_limitations: One position, assigned by structural equivalence. Discriminates subfamily, not compound.

source: Computed: bll6423 (Q89GC2, 194 aa) vs 37 reviewed EC 1.13.11.4 / 1.13.11.27 / 1.13.11.15 proteins
claim_tested: the locus encodes a gentisate-type ring cleavage that would make fumarylpyruvate the substrate
key_finding: Best SW score 46 at 31.6% over 95 columns (barley HPPD, 434 aa); all hits are short partial alignments to proteins 348-434 aa long
confidence_and_limitations: Limits the Arg93 inference. Rules out a gentisate route in this operon, not elsewhere in the genome.
